body: Added structured logging to every silent-failure branch and a bounded 5s retry when a fetch succeeds but yields zero ticker refs -- targets the timing-race hypothesis directly. 6 new tests against a fake HTTP server, go test ./... green. Live: rebuilt+restarted fatbaby-prwatch.service, monitored ~90min real traffic, no regressions, tickers still found when present. Specific race didn't recur in this window (bursty traffic); mechanism proven by deterministic tests, new logging will surface it live next occurrence. Forward-only -- already-persisted empty records need a separate backfill (S160-05). Commit bc902ed.
title: discoverTickers silent-empty fix (S160-01/S159-01)
